backup.title: Backup
backup.guide: Backups are optional. With no destination, the library still works offline. A configured backup is encrypted by restic before upload. Download the recovery file and keep it off this server. Do not add lifecycle expiration, storage-class transition, or object lock on the bucket: those rules delete or freeze objects restic still needs. QiJuan retention is the only cleanup. Deleted books stay inside snapshots until that retention removes the snapshot.
backup.r2Hint: Fills the endpoint template, region auto, and path-style addressing. Live R2 was not tested.
backup.accessKept: An access key is already saved. Leave this blank to keep it. It ends with
backup.secretKept: A secret key is already saved. Leave this blank to keep it.
backup.recoveryHint: This is the restic repository password. It is shown once and is not stored in the database.
backup.shown: Copy this password now. It will not be shown again.
backup.retentionHint: Defaults are 7 daily, 4 weekly, and 6 monthly. Retention runs only after a successful backup. Deleted books remain in the snapshots that are kept.
backup.indexedHint: Indexed folders are included only when selected. A metadata-only backup never includes them.
backup.indexedIncluded: Indexed folders are included in this backup.
backup.metadataLabel: This backup is metadata-only. It does not include book files.
backup.confirm: Replace this library with the snapshot
backup.activated: Restore activated. Sign in again with an account from the snapshot.
backup.deletedKept: A retained snapshot still contains books that were deleted later, until retention removes that snapshot.
backup.integrityHint: An integrity check reads the restic repository. It does not restore a snapshot, and it is not proof that a restore will succeed.
backup.restoreTestHint: A restore test copies the newest snapshot into a temporary folder and checks it. It does not replace this library. That is separate from an integrity check.
backup.subtitle: Encrypted snapshots to storage you control.

trash.title: Trash
trash.lede: Removed books and files wait here until you restore them or delete them. Trash is never emptied on its own.
trash.emptyHint: Books you remove from the library wait here.
trash.deleteBookConfirm: Delete “{title}” permanently? Its catalog record, reading state, shelves and notes go too. Uploaded files are erased from QiJuan's storage. Folder files are only removed from QiJuan and stay on disk. This cannot be undone.
trash.deleteFileConfirm: Delete “{name}” permanently? An uploaded file is erased from QiJuan's storage. A folder file is only removed from QiJuan and stays on disk. This cannot be undone.
trash.removeConfirm: Move “{title}” to Trash? It leaves the library, search and OPDS. You can restore it from Trash with its reading state, shelves and notes.
trash.removeFileConfirm: Move “{name}” to Trash? The book keeps its other files, and you can restore this one from Trash.
